842: 	// use reservoir sampling because the number of available
843: 	// hosts isn't known: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reservoir_sampling
844: 	var randomHost *Upstream

847: 		if !upstream.Available() {

851: 		// upstream will always be chosen if there is at

part.text:
Fixed in `modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy/selectionpolicies.go:658`. The sticky session cookie set by `CookieHashSelection.Select` now includes:

- `SameSite: http.SameSiteNoneMode` — always, so the `lb` cookie is sent to Caddy even on cross-site requests from third-party links
- `Secure: req.TLS != nil` — set automatically for HTTPS requests (browsers require `Secure` when `SameSite=None`)

All cookie hash policy tests pass, including the new `TestCookieHashPolicyWithSecureRequest` (which verifies `Secure=true` and `SameSite=None` on HTTPS) plus the full `reverseproxy` package suite.
